title: VooPoo PNP Replacement Pods
description: Please note: Coils must be purchased separately - Voopoo PNP Coils With the Drag S and Drag X, vape innovators Voopoo have redefined their bestselling range of box mods into a sleek new Pod Mod form that boasts all the same power and functionality with innovative ergonomics and a host of advanced features. These replacement, refillable pods for are compatible with both Voopoo Drag S and Voopoo Drag X models and are made from durable PCTG materials with a comfortable mouthpiece and excellent airflow. They’re also incredibly simple to use: a bottom refill system makes topping up your e-liquid a clean and fuss-free process and compatibility with all of Voopoo’s range of excellent PnP (Plug and Play) coils makes swapping out a new coil as easy as push to fit. The PnP coils offer multiple resistances to help you find the perfect vape.
